milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the cornflower (placed at spawn-relative [5, 0, 3]) and face toward it. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk at least ~1 block from spawn toward the flower (since spawn is ~5.83 blocks away), preventing trivial completion by just turning in place. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the cornflower, modeling 'the player has found and is observing the blue flower'.
